title: Annotatio III §.X (1) cont.: Forbes points to Picherellus and Spalatinus among Pontificians themselves
pass_a_gloss: Most Reverend William Forbes, besides many of the most learned Protestants who have most lucidly shown the dogma of Transsubstantiation adverse to the Scriptures, also begs the reader to go and from the Pontificians themselves read and most diligently consider Picherellus’s learned Exposition of the Institution-words of the Lord’s Supper and the same man’s Dissertation on the Mass, and also Archbishop Spalatinus book 5 De Republica Ecclesiastica chapter 6, most fully attacking and refuting this dogma, newest Fabricius edition p. 600 in the middle.
pass_b_english: Forbes, with many learned Protestants, has shown the dogma adverse to Scripture.
He also begs readers to weigh Pontificians against themselves: Picherellus on the Institution-words and the Mass, and Spalatinus De Republ. Eccles. 5.6 (Fabricius p. 600) refuting it at length.
source_text: Reverendiss. Guil. Forbesius præter multos ex Doctissimis Protestantibus, qui dogma Transsubstantiationis Scripturis adversari luculentissimè demonstrarunt, obsecrat quoque lectorem, adire, ex pontificiis ipsis, eruditam Picherelli Expositionem verborum Institutionis Coenæ Domini & ejusdem Dissertat. de Missa legere diligentissimeque considerare, necnon Archi-Ep. Spalatinum l. 5. de Republ. Eccles. cap. 6., fusissime hoc dogma impugnantem & refellentem Edit. Fabrician. noviss. p. 600. in media.
